meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划交给它,自动拆成并行任务并逐步跑完
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有详细计划但不想手动一项项执行。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan to completion with parallel tasks and tracked progress
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a detailed plan and want it executed without doing each step by hand.

howto.what: Claude 不再自己写代码,而是执行 .omo/plans 里写好的工作计划:把编码、测试、QA 派给子代理并行完成,自己只做拆解、派活、判定与记录证据,每个阶段在独立 git worktree 内进行,直到计划复选框全部完成。
howto.when: 当你说出 “ulw-execute”、“start work” 等,或要求运行 .omo/plans 里的工作计划时触发;没有可选的计划时,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再继续。

say.note: 它会选计划、写 Boulder 状态并开始派活

say.text: 用 ulw-execute --make-pr 执行这个计划
say.note: 每个阶段改成开 PR 交付
持续跟进 CI 和评审直到 PR 合并

howto.what_en: Claude writes no code itself: it runs a plan under .omo/plans by delegating all coding, testing and QA to parallel subagents, keeping only dispatch, verdicts and evidence, one git worktree per phase, until every checkbox is done.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "ulw-execute" or "start work", or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans; if no plan is selectable it first runs ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Picks the plan, writes Boulder state, starts dispatching.
Each phase is delivered as a pull request.
Stays until the PR is merged, handling CI and review.
